faces.transcription:
A SECOND ALIAS

“We got you some new aliases. Congratulations, you’ve just been hired by an international construction and renovation firm. Shame though; I hear they pay next to nothin’.”

RIGHT NOW
1 Put the 12 enclosed Action tokens by the side of the board to form a supply.
2 Add the enclosed Cover Occupation stickers and Specialization (Transport Crew) stickers to the second alias (the one with the 🌐) of each of the 4 passports.
3 Use disguises to modify these new aliases.
4 Give each of the second aliases a name.
5 Add the new stickers to the rules and Reference cards.
